To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the blockchain is not a silver bullet, and it cannot be applied to all smart cities use cases; 2) the blockchain is an appropriate technology for sharing-based smart city services; 3) the blockchain can be used to improve the quality of sharing-based smart city use cases; 4) blockchain-based smart cities are not only about the use of blockchain technology, they are also about the use of smart cities.
the blockchain technology has the potential to support the smart city paradigm by enabling a new type of sharing economy.
blockchain technology has the potential to contribute significantly to smart city initiatives, but that this technology will not be a panacea for the challenges that cities face today.
